parameters.query:
INSERT INTO "ContentPost" (
  "id",
  "title",
  "sourcePrompt",
  "contentType",
  "status",
  "linkedinContent",
  "newsletterContent",
  "websiteContent",
  "targetChannels",
  "metadata",
  "createdAt",
  "updatedAt"
) VALUES (
  $1,
  $2,
  $3,
  $4,
  'draft',
  $5,
  $6,
  $7,
  $8::jsonb,
  $9::jsonb,
  NOW(),
  NOW()
)
RETURNING *;

INSERT INTO "PublishingLog" (
  "id",
  "postId",
  "channel",
  "status",
  "publishedUrl",
  "responsePayload",
  "errorMessage",
  "createdAt"
)
SELECT
  x.id,
  x.post_id,
  x.channel,
  x.status,
  x.published_url,
  x.response_payload::jsonb,
  x.error_message,
  NOW()
FROM json_to_recordset($1::json) AS x(
  id text,
  post_id text,
  channel text,
  status text,
  published_url text,
  response_payload text,
  error_message text
)
RETURNING *;

UPDATE "ContentPost"
SET "status" = $2, "publishedAt" = NOW(), "updatedAt" = NOW()
WHERE "id" = $1
RETURNING *;
